name: git-status
description: Compact git status output showing branch and changed files without verbose help text
strip_lines_matching: ^\s*\(commit or discard the untracked or modified content\)

tests.name: strips help hints
tests.input:
On branch main
Your branch is up to date with 'origin/main'.

Changes not staged for commit:
  (use "git add <file>..." to update what will be committed)
  (use "git restore <file>..." to discard changes in working directory)
	modified:   src/main.py

no changes added to commit (use "git add" to track)
tests.expected:
On branch main
Your branch is up to date with 'origin/main'.
Changes not staged for commit:
	modified:   src/main.py
no changes added to commit (use "git add" to track)
